syncSegmentsEn.text: Oh, the great love of God
How long and wide and high and deep
He did not spare even His beloved only Son
But gave Him up for us all
Who can bring a charge against those God has justified?
Who can condemn them?
If God is for us, who can be against us?
Who can separate me from the love of God?
Can trouble or hardship?
Can persecution or hunger?
Can nakedness, danger, or the sword?
Neither height nor depth
Neither things present nor things to come
None of these can separate me from the love of God
